title: Polling on a schedule
hints: time.NewTicker(d) sends the current time on ticker.C every d. Receive from ticker.C before each check.
Always stop a ticker you're done with (defer ticker.Stop()), so the runtime can release it.
ticker := time.NewTicker(interval); defer ticker.Stop(); n := 0; for range ticker.C { n++; if check() { return n } }
